changes.oldText: On the Sessions tab, you can use the property filter to narrow the list — by Session ID when needed, by the session's owner (email or full name), by its project or domain, and by session attributes such as result, cluster mode, priority, and creation or termination time.

changes.oldText: Setting a quota on project-folder is similar to setting a user quota. The difference between setting project quota and user quota is to confirm setting the project quota requires one more procedure, which is selecting the domain that the project is dependent on. The rest are the same. As in the picture below, you need to first select the domain, and then select the project.
